artworks.title: Female Nude Seated
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. George Matthew Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a seated position, partially turned to the side, with their upper body exposed from the waist up. The person is resting their head on their folded arms, which are propped up on a surface. The facial features are detailed with a focused expression, and the person has short, slightly wavy hair. There is no clothing visible, as the sketch includes the depiction of their torso and arms. No jewelry or objects are noticeable. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure without additional context. The page is light with faint sketch lines around the figure, and a signature is present at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Profil de lumiere (Profile of light)
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of a person's face from the shoulders up. The person appears to be in a seated or standing position with their head slightly bowed. Their facial features include a prominent nose, closed eyes, and a serene expression. The hair is detailed with a middle parting cascading down the sides of the face. They are wearing a garment covering their shoulders, with a suggestion of a veil or draped fabric over their head. The background is dark and textured, contrasting with the lighter areas of the person's face and hair.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with a Rose
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures, one adult and one child. The child is seated on the adult's lap. The child has curly hair and chubby facial features. The adult looks down at the child. Both figures are clothed in flowing garments, with the adult's robe enveloping the child. The child's body is largely uncovered. In the background, there is textured fabric or abstract lines. The child holds a small rose in one hand, while the adult's hand supports the child. Both figures are surrounded by an ethereal glow or halo effect.

artworks.title: Fuga Deiparae in Aegyptum (The Flight into Egypt)
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 31.4 x 42.2 cm (12 3/8 x 16 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a meandering river, a townscape on the horizon, and various trees and foliage. In the foreground, there are figures engaged in different activities. The artwork is created using detailed etching techniques with a monochrome color palette. The sky features expressive clouds.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Saint Anne and Saint Joachim
artworks.description: The image shows five human figures and an infant in the center. On the left side, a woman with braided hair and a headpiece stands. Next to her, an older man with curly hair and a mustache wears a decorative hat and detailed robe. On the right, another woman holds the infant and looks down at them. Behind them is an elderly, bearded man with long hair. The background features a cloudy sky with cherubic faces and a bird with a halo above, surrounded by radiant lines.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with figures and architecture. A woman holds a child and rides a donkey while a man walks beside them. They are underneath a large tree. In the background, there is a rustic village with a bridge, watermill, and flowing river. The horizon includes a church spire. The image is created using detailed etching techniques, showcasing texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing intricate line work.

artworks.title: Christ and the Virgin Enthroned
artworks.description: The image shows two seated figures. The person on the left has blonde hair and is wearing a blue robe with green accents, with hands pressed together. The figure on the right has brown hair and a beard, wearing an orange robe with beige undergarments, with one hand raised. Both figures wear crowns and red halos, against a detailed, gold-accented floral background enclosed in a decorative frame.

artworks.title: The Genealogical Tree of the Dominicans
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored with tan ground and vermilion, rose, brown, gray-blue and a printed black
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length illustration of a central figure dressed in a long dark robe with a lighter inner lining, holding a staff adorned with a cross. His facial features are stylized with baldness on top and some hair around the sides, and his expression is serene, complemented by a halo around his head. Above this central figure is a holy figure, possibly a depiction of Jesus, sporting a crown and holding an orb and a cross, surrounded by a grapevine motif. Flanking the main figure are several other smaller religious figures, each in various seated or kneeling positions, with halos and distinctive robes. Each figure seems to be involved in some form of scholarly or religious activity, such as holding books or tools of the trade. The background is an intricate design of intertwining grapevines with leaves and clusters of grapes, all set against an earthy-toned backdrop. Additionally, a dog is featured at the bottom, interacting with a sphere or orb.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious figure surrounded by armored soldiers. The central figure has wounds on their body, wears a red cloak, and has a golden halo around their head. They hold a large cross staff with a banner displaying a red cross. Three armored soldiers are depicted in various postures. The background shows a landscape with hills and a distant town under a pastel-toned sky. The image is framed with an ornate golden border.

artworks.title: Ship in Full Sail with Two Flags
artworks.artist: Follower of Pieter Bruegel the Elder

artworks.title: Endpaper with Animals
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed  orange paper
artworks.description: The image features a collection of animal figures depicted in a golden hue against a vivid orange backdrop. The animals are arranged in rows and include various species such as a bear, wolf, horse, cow, camel, sheep, and others. There are a few smaller mythical or imaginative creatures scattered among the more recognizable animals. Some animals appear in dynamic poses while others stand in profile, and a few are interacting with each other. The illustration has a decorative quality, reminiscent of ancient or traditional art styles where each animal occupies a distinct space within the composition.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Animals
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed pink paper
artworks.description: The image features multiple intricate shapes on a pink background, forming outlines of animals such as deer, camels, and lions in gold color. The creatures are depicted in stylized postures with linear patterns and textures suggesting fur or scales.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Animals and Figures
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed rose paper
artworks.description: The image features golden shapes and lines against a reddish-brown background, creating an abstract composition. The shapes depict various animals such as horses, elephants, and deer. A tree shape is positioned in the center, surrounded by humans and animals.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Peasant Wedding
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed rose paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of various scenes and figures depicted on a red background. The image showcases a series of small vignettes arranged in horizontal rows across the canvas. Each vignette consists of gold-colored figures engaged in different activities. The figures are detailed and appear to be in historical costumes, and the scenes are bordered by a decorative frame. The bottom section of the image includes horse-drawn carriages and riders. The use of gold on the red background creates a striking contrast, emphasizing the ornate elements of the composition.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Scenes from the Life of a Knight
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed aqua paper
artworks.description: The image features a series of intricate figures and motifs arranged within a stylized border on a blue backdrop. Silhouettes of trees, archways, and walls create an outdoor space that interlinks with a castle-like structure with arches. Characters in historical garments are engaged in various activities, including confrontations, courtly interactions, and marching. The figures are detailed in a coppery hue contrasting with the blue background. The drawing is structured like a tapestry or embroidery, with narrative scenes divided into distinct sections, each capturing different aspects of a story.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Scenes of the Trades
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed pale yellow paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing displaying various scenes in separate vignettes on a single plane. The drawing features multiple figures engaging in different activities. The scenes are arranged horizontally, creating the effect of a narrative scroll. The image uses limited color, with the main visual elements in a tone similar to red, orange, or rust against a pale background. This gives the work an antique appearance, suggesting it may be an etching or engraving in a traditional illustrative style.

artworks.title: Endpaper with the Twelve Months
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed  purple paper
artworks.description: The image displays a grid-like arrangement of rectangular sections. Each section contains intricate fine lines forming distinct shapes. The design may depict scenes familiar from everyday life such as figures, houses, and landscapes. The scenes are organized in a calendar-like format, with labeled sections for months.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Twelve Standing Figures
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed  orange paper
artworks.description: The image is a decorative print featuring twelve sections, each depicting a different person. Most figures are shown in full length, allowing their entire bodies to be visible. Each person is standing and captured in a dynamic pose. Their facial features are stylized and not highly detailed. Hairstyles vary but generally complement the period costumes they wear, which are richly detailed with thick fabrics and elaborate patterns. Each person is shown in an archway and dressed in costumes that suggest different characters or occupations. Some figures hold objects, such as canes, musical instruments, or other items. Jewelry isn't prominently featured, but the opulence of the clothing itself conveys wealth and status. The background consists of a bright orange hue with each figure set against a decorated archway.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Twenty-One Standing Figures
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed blue-green paper
artworks.description: This is a print of a grid containing various human figures. It features a meticulously organized grid with several rectangular sections, each containing an individual human figure dressed in a variety of costumes or roles. Each figure is accompanied by a label below, written in a script style. The figures are depicted in a gold or yellowish tone against a deep green background, creating a striking contrast. The border of the grid is adorned with intricate designs.

artworks.title: Saints Cyprian, Vitus, Stephan, and Cornelius
artworks.description: The image features four figures depicted upright from head to toe, each with a halo. The person on the far left has short, curly hair, wearing a decorated robe and holding a book, gesturing with the other hand. Next to him, the second figure also has short, curly hair and wears a striped robe, holding a staff. The third person has short hair under a blue and white cap, in a striped robe, holding a book while gesturing. The fourth figure has curly hair under a pointed cap, wearing a robe with blue and red detailing, holding a book with one hand raised. The background is a parchment-like surface with decorative red lining at the border.

artworks.title: Initials V and D
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate and intricate decorative design. The design features elaborate scrolling patterns and motifs in red lines accented with green and lavender within areas filled with these colors. The pattern is complex and intertwines with itself. The background is a mix of greens and purples that contrast with the detailed linework. Below this design is a portion of text with gothic-style calligraphy in a dark hue. The edge of the page shows signs of aging.

artworks.title: Die Herpavck vnd andere Drvmmen zvernst vnd Schimpf wir lassen ervmmen
artworks.description: The image shows two men, one playing a kettledrum and the other playing a trumpet-like wind instrument. The man playing the kettledrum wears a hat with a feather, a beard, a shirt with puffed sleeves, knee-length puffed pants, stockings, and shoes with bows. The man playing the wind instrument leans against a column and wears a similar hat, a garment with buttons, gathered pants, and stockings. Both men focus on playing their instruments. The background is plain with a border and text below the image.

artworks.title: Gantz loblich Pfeiffen wir all drei avs der Mvsic: Schon Melodey
artworks.description: The image shows three men playing musical instruments. Two men play bagpipes while the man in the center plays a flageolet. They are dressed in historical clothing with puffed sleeves and trousers. Each man wears a cap with feathers and has well-groomed facial hair. The background is a simple indoor setting. A line of decorative text is printed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Die Instrvment gantz lvstig Kling vorab wen man darein tvt singen
artworks.description: Three men are depicted playing musical instruments. The person on the left is seated with a lute, looking to the right, wearing a period costume. In the middle, a man is playing a trumpet. The third man on the right plays a harp. Each musician is focused on their instrument. The image has a textured paper border and text at the bottom.
